answer: A $40 chip stops clone farms cold. One TPM per identity, and the jade seal it earns cannot move to another machine. The atlas maps each chip batch to its factory, so 100 chips from one batch trigger a $300 factory audit per device past the tenth. Three labs re-check random batches weekly, and one failed chip voids the whole batch, dropping every identity in it to zero weight. 100 clones cost $400 plus 90 times $340, $31,000, against $4,000 for 100 honest agents. Forged records land in the fable ledger for all to see. Like a locksmith who stamps each key once, a copied key opens nothing.
